digest.component_or_area: BindingStore persistence, lifecycle, and recovery subsystem
propositions: BindingStore module is 799 lines and conflates byte persistence, lifecycle policy, retirement, recovery, peer-state delegates, comment identity, and rotation—requiring internal decomposition behind one unchanged public facade.

Shallow-mutable access via all_bindings() compatibility query enables production code to mutate inner entries without triggering persistence, risking silent data loss when new safety rules have no cohesive owner.

Live recovery must run after staleness validation but before remote issue observation to prevent interleaving new liveness evidence with interrupted-retirement completion without rewriting coherent stores.

Durable tombstone retirement intent can only be revoked by explicit unretire, never by automatic liveness observations or stale absent_404_count resets, requiring exact-match identity agreement across all three pairs before completion.

Extract three internal owners—repository/unit-of-work, lifecycle policy, and recovery—while preserving all five existing serialization invariants: unknown fields, indent=2, sorted keys, trailing newline, and unchanged-pass byte/HEAD idempotency.
